lines.en: Nina, look at these tomatoes! Prices have been rising for months, and I have been noticing it every Saturday.
lines.pt: Nina, olhe esses tomates! Os preços vêm subindo há meses, e eu venho notando isso todo sábado.

lines.en: I know. I’ve been coming to this market since I was a student, and it has never been this expensive.
lines.pt: Eu sei. Venho a esta feira desde que era estudante, e nunca esteve tão cara.

lines.en: The farmers have been complaining about fuel costs, and the weather has been making things worse.
lines.pt: Os agricultores vêm reclamando dos custos de combustível, e o clima tem piorado as coisas.

lines.en: Have you been buying less lately? I have been cooking more at home, because I can hardly afford eating out.
lines.pt: Você tem comprado menos ultimamente? Eu tenho cozinhado mais em casa, porque mal consigo pagar para comer fora.

lines.en: Yes, and I’ve been looking for cheaper stalls. A friend has been telling me about a place near the river.
lines.pt: Sim, e tenho procurado bancas mais baratas. Uma amiga tem me falado de um lugar perto do rio.

lines.en: Interesting. How long has that stall been operating? Some of the new ones have been disappearing quickly.
lines.pt: Interessante. Há quanto tempo essa banca funciona? Algumas das novas têm desaparecido rápido.

lines.en: For about two years. The owner has been selling local vegetables, and customers have been joining the queue since eight.
lines.pt: Há uns dois anos. O dono tem vendido legumes locais, e os clientes vêm entrando na fila desde as oito.

lines.en: You look tired, Nina. Have you been sleeping properly, or have you been working too hard again?
lines.pt: Você parece cansada, Nina. Tem dormido direito, ou tem trabalhado demais de novo?

lines.en: Working too hard, I’m afraid. I have been preparing a presentation all week, and I’m exhausted.
lines.pt: Trabalhando demais, receio. Tenho preparado uma apresentação a semana toda e estou exausta.

lines.en: Then you deserve a treat. I’ve been saving money for a nice lunch, so let me invite you.
lines.pt: Então você merece um mimo. Venho guardando dinheiro para um bom almoço, então deixe-me convidá-la.

lines.en: That’s kind of you. After all these months of rising prices, a good meal has been exactly what I need.
lines.pt: Que gentileza. Depois de todos esses meses de preços subindo, uma boa refeição é exatamente o que eu preciso.

facts.label: Present perfect contínuo
facts.sub: Prices have been rising for months. I’ve been coming since 2015. How long have you been waiting?

facts.label: vêm fazendo
facts.sub: Use have/has been + -ing para algo que começou no passado e continua: Prices have been rising for months. Em português: vêm subindo, tenho feito. Mostra processo e tendência.

facts.label: há, desde
facts.sub: For + período: for months. Since + ponto de partida: since Monday, since 2020. Não use o presente simples com essas palavras: não diga I am here since Monday.

pages.title: Saturday at the market · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a bright Saturday morning in Glasgow. The market is full of people and colours. Tess and Nina walk between the stalls. They have been coming here for many years. This morning, something feels different. Higher prices are now a clear trend.

“Nina, look at these tomatoes! Prices have been rising for months, and I have been noticing it every Saturday.” says Tess. “I know. I’ve been coming to this market since I was a student, and it has never been this expensive.” says Nina. “The farmers have been complaining about fuel costs, and the weather has been making things worse.” says Tess.

You

Tess

Tess
